verdict.rationale: Workable's API exposes core candidate profile elements—candidate records, ratings/interview feedback (rate-candidate), offers, pipeline stages, and activity events—suggesting a unified candidate record exists. However, the evidence pack never explicitly confirms email thread capture/threading or a distinct consent-status field within the candidate profile, both called out in the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of email thread integration into candidate record, explicit consent/GDPR status field shown as part of the unified profile, and independent/hands-on confirmation that all these elements render together in one screen.
